## 1. Current Truth Statement

Raw V1 source logic coverage currently FAILS. RAW-REM-03 addresses only the 927 high-risk tax/fixation/indexation remediation-scope items. It does not address the 234 source-uncertain RAW-REM-01 items, the 732 RAW-REM-02 items retained for real mapping, or RAW-REM-04 through RAW-REM-10. This package does not fix full raw logic coverage, does not modify behavior/golden/REQ maps, does not authorize implementation, and 02M remains frozen.

## 3. Domain Boundaries

Included boundaries are retirement age and eligibility; gender/date/year rules; Israeli tax brackets and marginal-tax source logic; annual tax parameters; credit points; exemptions; pension-related exemption rules present in source; severance/grants tax treatment; fixation rights and 161D; exemption allocation; historical indexation, CPI/madad, and CBS/LMAS access; prisa/tax spread source logic; and explicitly scoped tax/fixation output fields.

Excluded unless explicitly tax/fixation/indexation-related are clearinghouse and balance-ledger behavior, pension-coefficient or annuity conversion, generic scenario/cashflow behavior, generic report layout, and generic validation behavior. The committed 927-ID scope remains authoritative.

## 4. Mapping Outcome Method

Allowed outcomes: `TAXMAP_NEEDS_BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT`, `TAXMAP_NEEDS_FORMULA_RULE_CONTRACT`, `TAXMAP_NEEDS_GOLDEN_EXPECTED_OUTPUT`, `TAXMAP_NEEDS_BEHAVIOR_AND_GOLDEN`, `TAXMAP_NEEDS_REQ_MAPPING`, `TAXMAP_NEEDS_V1ITEM_LINK`, `TAXMAP_NEEDS_DOMAIN_DECISION`, `TAXMAP_NEEDS_MANUAL_SOURCE_REVIEW`, `TAXMAP_INTENTIONAL_CHANGE_CANDIDATE_WITH_REASON`, `TAXMAP_NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON`, `TAXMAP_OUT_OF_SCOPE_FOR_RAW_REM_03`, `TAXMAP_UNCLASSIFIED_FAIL`. `TAXMAP_NEEDS_*` outcomes identify future evidence artifacts and remain blocking. Intentional-change and not-applicable outcomes require explicit source reasons. Out-of-scope routing requires a named later RAW-REM package. `TAXMAP_UNCLASSIFIED_FAIL` forces package failure. No outcome in this report changes application behavior or the original audit.
